steps.title: Models
steps.decision: Choose a model profile from task quality, latency, cost, modality, privacy, and eval results.
steps.practice: Compare fast, balanced, and reasoning profiles on the same cases.

steps.title: Prompt and Context
steps.decision: Separate stable instructions, request instructions, examples, and untrusted evidence.
steps.practice: Compare full-history context with selected evidence context.

steps.title: Structured Output
steps.decision: Use schemas when software consumes model output; validate business rules separately.
steps.practice: Run the schema validation example against valid and invalid payloads.

steps.title: Embeddings and Vector Search
steps.decision: Start with lexical search; add semantic or hybrid retrieval only for measured gaps.
steps.practice: Build exact-term and paraphrase retrieval cases.

steps.title: RAG
steps.decision: Use retrieval for changing or private evidence with provenance and permissions.
steps.practice: Build a small corpus and retrieval eval set.

steps.title: Tool Calling
steps.decision: Use typed tools for current facts and deterministic actions.
steps.practice: Expose two read-only tools and validate inputs and outputs.

steps.title: MCP
steps.decision: Use MCP when several AI clients benefit from shared discovery and governed capabilities.
steps.practice: Compare direct tools with the read-only MCP workspace lab.

steps.title: Agents
steps.decision: Use bounded agents only when the next useful step depends on changing evidence.
steps.practice: Run a tool loop with step budget, duplicate-call protection, and stop states.

steps.title: Memory and State
steps.decision: Separate request context, history, user preferences, durable application state, and cache.
steps.practice: Model an explicit state machine for a multi-step task.

steps.title: Evals
steps.decision: Use golden cases and deterministic graders before tuning prompts, models, or agents.
steps.practice: Run a small regression dataset and fail the process on a critical case.

steps.title: Observability
steps.decision: Trace model, retrieval, tools, agent steps, versions, latency, and cost end to end.
steps.practice: Design the trace needed to explain one wrong production answer.

steps.title: Security and Governance
steps.decision: Treat external content as untrusted and keep identity, policy, secrets, and approvals outside model control.
steps.practice: Add prompt-injection and permission-denied eval cases.

steps.title: Deployment
steps.decision: Release model behavior with eval gates, budgets, degraded modes, and rollback.
steps.practice: Deploy one lab with explicit versions and a rollback drill.
